title: Path to $3.32 — what the market price implies (reverse DCF)
reading: At r=15%, g=10%, the $3.32 price needs retained revenue of $188,611,764/yr — 8.5x today's R₀. At the current 31.60% capture and 15.36 bps fee rate that means $388.6B of annual Intents volume (8.5x today's annualised volume), or $49,739,389 of gross fees every 30 days. Capture alone cannot get there: with volume flat, the price needs a 270% capture rate — impossible. Even at 100% capture with volume flat, the DCF ceiling is $1.23 (37% of the price). The price is a bet on volume growth, not on retention.
